changelog: `apm install --frozen` with MCP servers prints its MCP targeting line once instead of twice, at project and user scope (#4217)

ledger_row.summary: The frozen MCP check selected target runtimes through the announcing resolver before the install run announced them again, so install --frozen printed its 'Targeting ...' line twice.

red: APM_BINARY_PATH="$(uv run which apm)" uv run --extra dev pytest tests/integration/test_frozen_replay_output_lifecycle.py -k targeting_line_once -n 0 -p no:cacheprovider -q -> I9 oracle: stdout '[i] Targeting declared targets from apm.yml: claude, copilot' twice (assert 5 == 4) and '[i] Targeting specific runtime: claude' twice (assert 7 == 6); 2 failed
owner: src/apm_cli/integration/mcp_integrator_install.py (_resolve_target_runtimes, new select_target_runtimes_quietly for pre-checks); callers routed: src/apm_cli/install/service_integration.py (frozen check), src/apm_cli/install/dry_run_plan.py (dry-run preview, replaces its private _SilentLogger); SilentLogger lives in src/apm_cli/core/null_logger.py
notes: Flips J06 s4 frozen-mcp-targets-line-twice and J10 s4 J10-frozen-global-repeats-targeting-line (PR #4156). Observed but out of scope: user-scope 'apm install -g --frozen' creates empty directories ~/.claude and ~/.apm/apm_modules on a converged state (no file bytes change); the test compares file bytes only.
